description: Team ArgentinaSpace — Systems & Quality Lead building AETHER-SIM, a physics-based planetary analog calibration and 1:1 EVA traverse twinning engine. Using NASA POWER, GIBS, and Moon/Mars Trek data, we quantify Earth's gravity/thermal test biases and 4D seasonal validity windows across high-altitude Andean and global analog sites to de-risk Artemis and Mars surface missions.
